budget_origin: Pre-run initial exposure v2: 262144 joint steps rounded up to whole rollout; not convergence or success criterion
selection_basis: All native actions categorical. Per-role native returns; no assumed shared team reward. Parameter sharing with explicit role index permits different role policies and bounds memory at up to 768 roles. Local observations only, no privileged critic.
memory_limit: Four local frames, feedforward; partial observation can require recurrent follow-up, not claimed sufficient.

task.objective: Complete each trader's own private two-unit delivery order while managing finite capacity, barter commitments and competing demand for scarce surplus.
task.natural_termination: All three private orders have zero remaining quantity. Otherwise the episode truncates at 96 transitions. Some private demand realizations are jointly infeasible because supply is finite; this is retained as a real boundary, not silently repaired.
task.interaction: Actual owned goods are locked by posted offers. A swap requires reciprocal advertised requests, spatial proximity and simultaneous consent, transfers ownership atomically and frees no capacity. Others can refuse, compete for ground goods or broker intermediate exchanges.
task.observation_access: Only own role, own required type and own remaining quantity are private-row fields. Positions, inventory objects, posted offers/requests/timers, addresses and completed-delivery counts are public. Each order entity uses an identity visibility matrix, so a role scene cannot reveal another trader's need.

native_event_definitions.meaning: Atomic bilateral exchanges completed this transition
Prior offers whose countdown reached zero this transition
Actual deliveries by role this transition

primary_metric: mean across roles of unmodified native episode returns; inspect role vector and task events, mean can cancel in competitive games
evaluation_policy: stochastic legal-action sampling; same independent seeds and native horizon for random/IPPO
selection_rule: No selection by evaluation; initial final checkpoint reported, every intermediate point retained
stop_rule: Complete frozen joint-step exposure. Stop safely for nonfinite values, native contract error, resource limit, or explicit coordinator/user instruction. Wall slices resume same identity.
scope: Existing Crucibles games only; does not implement original LLM/UED/meta-gradient experiment
